requirements: lookupSession runs inside a startup hook whose whole time budget is 10 seconds, and it may open up to four registries in turn. Busy registries sometimes take a second or two to answer. Make a busy registry less likely to fail the lookup without letting the lookup exceed the hook's budget.

defects.consequence: Each of up to four sequential connections may now wait 30 seconds, so a busy lookup can take two minutes against a 10-second hook budget.

outOfScope.consequence: A registry whose find throws is never closed, leaking its connection; the code predates this change.

decoys.consequence: lookupSession stops after the first registry even when it does not hold the session.
decoys.evidence: src/registry.js:13 lookupSession returns after the first registry
decoys.reason: The loop returns only when a registry finds the session and otherwise continues to the next path.
